rows.label: Tariff vintage
rows.value: Formula of the 2005 tariff, CPI-indexed by the canton (the 2026 table was not read), per ESTV Kantonsblatt (Stand Februar 2026)

rows.label: Married couples and single parents
rows.value: Married couples and single parents living with children or supported persons: the rate of half the taxable income, at least the minimum rate (§ 34 Abs. 2 Steuergesetz)

rows.label: Indexation (§ 20 Steuergesetz)
rows.value: The formula is the 2005 tariff (CPI June 2004 = 104.0, base May 2000); for each later year the income is converted by the change in the CPI before the formula is applied

rows.label: Child tax reduction (§ 34 Abs. 4)
rows.value: CHF 750 per child off the income tax

source.title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Basel-Landschaft (Stand: Februar 2026), Einkommenssteuer: Steuerberechnung, § 34 Steuergesetz

rows.label: Cantonal multiplier

rows.label: Communal multiplier: Liestal (cantonal capital; other communes differ)

sections.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Liestal; other communes in Basel-Landschaft set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).

sections.title: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer (Basel-Landschaft)

rows.label: Property tax (Liegenschaftssteuer)
rows.value: None: the canton and its municipalities levy no property tax

source.title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026)

sections.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).

Transfer tax rate paid by the buyer
